title: ia position honours rule activation
summary: ia position now reserves a blocking rule in rules only where its activation admits the key's coordinate, as ia context delivers it. A rule whose activation the coordinate contradicts moves to a new omittedRules section of ia.position-body.v1 with the contradictory terms, as ia context reports them, and is never loaded, pointed to or listed as applying by word. A rule left undecided because its activation names an axis the key does not bind, such as move, stays in rules with an activation field naming the groups it waits on. The text view prints both. The runtime exports the RuleRecord and OmittedRule types.
